description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView Adapter named UsageListAdapter used to display a list of usage statistics entries, including app icons, package names, and last used times.

classes.name: UsageListAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView Adapter that presents a list of custom usage statistics entries, including app package name, last used time, and app icon.

classes.name: UsageListAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class holding references to the views for each list item: package name, last time used, and app icon.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates the layout for individual list items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from the usage stats list to the views in each ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the usage stats list.

methods.name: setCustomUsageStatsList
methods.description: Sets the list of CustomUsageStats objects to be displayed.
